title: 第一卷 第2章 他不想体面，那就帮他体面！
content_zh:
陈渊一愣，随即坚定地说道：“陆大叔，你坚持住，我一定想办法，压制你体内的邪气。”

    糯米也连忙拉着陆承锋的衣角，眼眶泛红：“爹爹，阿渊哥一定能救你的，你要坚持住啊！”

    “糯米已经是单亲家庭了，不想再成为孤儿！”

    陈渊无奈地笑了笑，揉了揉小糯米的小脑袋。

    陆承锋看向女儿，眸中的猩红渐渐褪去，语气柔和了许多：“好，爹爹听糯米的，再坚持坚持。”

    说完，他再次看向陈渊，神色又沉了几分。

    “柳家不会善罢甘休的，他们这次迫不及待地想抓走糯米，难道，是知道了糯米体内有邪神灵种？”

    “所以，他们想把糯米带到黑山，当成‘福猪’献祭给邪神？”

    所谓福猪，便是将活人当作烧猪，用来祭祀天穹上那枚血红的月亮。

    至于黑山，是武桥镇大名鼎鼎的凶地。

    在山上，住着一个大树异化的邪祟，人称——黑山姥姥。

    听到这话，陈渊目光一凝。

    他也猜测到了，柳三爷突然变卦，定是勾结上了黑山姥姥。

    为此，他才不惜用自己的女儿，去笼络执法司司长。

    甚至可能连武桥镇的镇守大人也被拉拢。

    说不定，那镇守大人，本就和黑山姥姥沆瀣一气。

    毕竟这些年来，武桥镇频频有少男少女失踪，却始终查不到去向······这原因，不是官方无能，就是官方，也是合伙人。

    陈渊神色阴沉地思索着，这世界的黑暗，远比他想象的还要黑。

    随即他看向陆承锋，眸中冷冽的道：“有这个可能，若不然，以那柳三爷的秉性，不会如此迫切，一大早过来抓人。”

    说到这里，陈渊拳头紧握，“陆大叔放心，我不会让他们得逞的。”

    陆承锋嘴角噙着一抹意味深长，“那你，打算如何做？”

    陈渊眸中杀气暴涨，“我去杀他全家！”

    这话明明是狠辣至极······但在一对看似平民父女的面前，却是显得异常淡定。

    “对，杀他全家！”

    尤其是糯米，竟然兴奋地嚷嚷起来，小脸上满是狠劲，“敢把糯米当福猪？干不死他！”

    陆承锋神色冷酷，始终是面无表情地盯着陈渊，沉声问道：“什么时候去？”

    “事不宜迟，现在就去。”

    陈渊看向他，回应道。

    陆承锋颔首，眸光猩红之芒似乎压制不住了。

    他看了陈渊，竟是舔了舔嘴唇。

    可是很快，他似乎压制了，立即转身走进了里屋。

    下一秒，屋内便传来一阵阵野兽般的低沉嘶吼。

    这与他平日里老实憨厚，判若两人。

    陈渊沉默地站在原地，神色复杂。

    小糯米跑到屋门口，偷偷往里面瞥了一眼，随即转身对着陈渊吐了吐舌头，俏皮地说道：

    “渊哥哥，爹爹在啃昨天打猎回来的山鸡呢，哎呀，生吃啊，好残忍哦。”

    陈渊无奈地叮嘱道：“你好好照顾自己，我出去一趟，还有，先离你爹远一点。”

    小糯米眼睛眯成月牙状，眸子里闪烁着星钻般的光芒。

    她激动地拉着他的衣角，恳求道：“杀柳家全家吗？我也去！”

    陈渊轻轻摇头，拒绝了她。

    “你别看我小呀，我打不过，但是我会喊六六六呀！”

    糯米不死心，继续软磨硬泡。

    这些俏皮话，都是陈渊平日里教她的，她觉得有趣，时常挂在嘴边。

    陈渊还是摇了摇头，反复叮嘱她在家好好照顾陆承锋后，便从灶房拿起一把菜刀。

    他将菜刀别在腰间，独自出了门。

    ——————

    此刻天已蒙蒙亮，一颗太阳冉冉升起。

    只是这太阳表面蒙着一层厚重的黑气，宛若日全食一般。
content_en:
Chen Yuan was stunned for a moment, then said firmly: "Uncle Lu, hold on, I will find a way to suppress the evil spirit in your body."

    Nuomi also hurriedly pulled the corner of Lu Chengfeng's clothes, her eyes flushed: "Dad, Brother A Yuan will definitely save you, you have to hold on!"

    "Nuomi is already a single-parent family and doesn't want to be an orphan again!"

    Chen Yuan smiled helplessly and rubbed Xiao Nuomi's little head.

    Lu Chengfeng looked at his daughter, the scarlet in his eyes gradually faded, and his tone became much softer: "Okay, daddy, listen to Nuomi and keep insisting."

    After saying that, he looked at Chen Yuan again, his expression a little darker.

    "The Liu family will not give up. They can't wait to capture Nuomi this time. Could it be that they know that there is an evil spirit seed in Nuomi?"

    "So, they want to bring glutinous rice to Black Mountain and sacrifice it to the evil god as a 'lucky pig'?"

    The so-called lucky pig means that a living person is used as a roast pig to sacrifice to the blood-red moon in the sky.

    As for Black Mountain, it is the famous murderous place in Wuqiao Town.

    On the mountain, there lived an evil spirit who had transformed from a big tree, and was known as Grandma Black Mountain.

    Hearing this, Chen Yuan's eyes narrowed.

    He also guessed that Master Liu suddenly changed his mind and must have colluded with Grandma Heishan.

    For this reason, he did not hesitate to use his daughter to win over the director of the Law Enforcement Department.

    Maybe even the guardian of Wuqiao Town has been won over.

    Maybe, the Lord Guard is in cahoots with Grandma Heishan.

    After all, over the years, boys and girls have frequently disappeared in Wuqiao Town, but their whereabouts have never been traced... This is because either the officials are incompetent, or they are also partners.

    Chen Yuan thought gloomily, the darkness in this world was far darker than he imagined.

    Then he looked at Lu Chengfeng and said with cold eyes: "It's possible. If not, with Liu Sanye's nature, he wouldn't be so eager to come here early in the morning to arrest someone."

    Having said this, Chen Yuan clenched his fists, "Don't worry, Uncle Lu, I won't let them succeed."

    There was a meaningful expression on Lu Chengfeng's lips, "Then, what are you going to do?"

    Chen Yuan's eyes surged with murderous intent, "I'm going to kill his whole family!"

    These words were obviously extremely cruel...but in front of a father and daughter who looked like ordinary people, they seemed unusually calm.

    "Yes, kill his whole family!"

    Especially Nuomi, she shouted excitedly, her little face full of fierceness, "You dare to treat Nuomi as a lucky pig? You can't kill him!"

    Lu Chengfeng looked cold and stared at Chen Yuan expressionlessly, asking in a deep voice: "When are you going?"

    "Without further ado, let's go now."

    Chen Yuan looked at him and responded.

    Lu Chengfeng nodded, the scarlet light in his eyes seemed to be uncontrollable.

    He looked at Chen Yuan and actually licked his lips.

    But soon, he seemed to suppress it and immediately turned around and walked into the back room.

    The next second, there were waves of deep beast-like roars coming from the room.

    This is completely different from his usual honest and honest nature.

    Chen Yuan stood silently, with a complicated look on his face.

    Little Nuomi ran to the door of the house, peeked inside secretly, then turned around and stuck out her tongue to Chen Yuan, saying playfully:

    "Brother Yuan, daddy is eating the pheasant that we returned from hunting yesterday. Oh, it's so cruel to eat it raw."

    Chen Yuan helplessly warned: "You take good care of yourself, I'll go out, and stay away from your father first."

    Xiao Nuomi's eyes narrowed into crescent shapes, and their eyes shone like star diamonds.

    She excitedly pulled on the corner of his clothes and begged: "Kill the entire Liu family? I'll go too!"

    Chen Yuan shook his head gently and rejected her.

    "Don't think I'm young, I can't beat you, but I can shout six six six!"

    The glutinous rice did not give up and continued to grind and soak.

    These witticisms were all taught to her by Chen Yuan on weekdays. She found them interesting and often kept them on her lips.

    Chen Yuan still shook his head, and after repeatedly telling her to take good care of Lu Chengfeng at home, he picked up a kitchen knife from the kitchen.

    He put the kitchen knife on his waist and went out alone.

    ——————

    At this moment, the sky is dark and the sun is rising slowly.

    It's just that the sun's surface is covered with a thick layer of black air, just like a total solar eclipse.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 2 If he doesn’t want to be decent, then help him be decent!
